paragraphs.text: Multiple critical vulnerabilities in widely deployed infrastructure components including PHP, Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS, VMware vCenter, and ASUS Control Center Express are actively exploited or enable unauthenticated code execution, requiring immediate patching and configuration review to prevent compromise. Control owners must verify that affected systems are updated, management interfaces are not exposed to the internet, and authentication controls are enforced.

A data breach at SBC Medical Group exposing 1.6 million records and an unpatched Windows zero-day allowing program execution from a locked screen highlight gaps in data protection and physical access controls. Data and privacy owners should confirm breach notification compliance and assess physical security compensating measures.
